name: 30115 · Canton, GA
findings: ZIP 30115 (Canton) has 121 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30115 (Canton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 30115 (Canton) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Hobby and sports organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 14 hobby and sports organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
